results.claim: recover_material_headers.py consumes the optional header fields in the same order and under the same flag/sentinel conditions as the pinned 0021bc18 code.
The final PEXTLB→PEXTLH→PEXEW operations transform the little-endian bytes of the AARRGGBB packed word into RGBA lane order.
The 1,024 lane fixtures inside recover_material_headers.py simulate all three PEXT operations starting from the original packed AARRGGBB scalar.
validate_material_headers.py enforces that every source header offset appears exactly once in the GLB export.

The current 35 GLBs contain exactly one primitive material headerOffset for every source geometry header; independent source-byte recomputation found no field or lane-scale mismatches across 12,080 headers.
The current parser's originalMaterialHeader fields are byte-preserving and expose source header RGBA values and lane scaling as source data, without asserting final glTF PBR equivalence.

evidence_sent.parser: Source audit: decoder starts at +8, reads flag0x100 float, AARRGGBB if texture sentinel or flags&6, then optional fields flags8/16/128/64, requires exact end. Pinned 0021bc18 has same conditions and order; its 120 instructions are matched to ELF bytes.
evidence_sent.lane_fixture: Existing parser fixtures begin with interleaved [x,0] bytes (already-expanded PEXTLB-like input), then model interleaving and lane swap. Independent full-chain packed scalar PEXTLB→PEXTLH→PEXEW emulation yielded RGBA on representative non-symmetric colors.
evidence_sent.validator: Validator checks each present primitive's fields against source bytes but only returns len(seen), with no required-source-set or duplicate-offset test. Separate independent audit across all 35 current GLBs found all 12,080 source header offsets exactly once, no mismatch or lane-scaling error. Both scripts ran successfully, and a source-alpha mutation was rejected.

limitations: Jev is advisory. Deterministic raw-source recomputation and the code path are authoritative for the specific checks. No retry was made to change review outcomes.
